definition_quote.value: "Practice of genetic counseling" means a communication process, conducted by one or more appropriately trained individuals that includes: (a) Estimating the likelihood of occurrence or recurrence of a birth defect or of any potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition...(b) Helping the individual, family, or health care provider...(c) Facilitating an individual's or family's...(d) Pursuant to a collaborative agreement: Ordering genetic tests or other evaluations...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of genetic counseling" means a communication process, conducted by one or more appropriately trained individuals

value: Estimating likelihood of occurrence/recurrence of birth defects or inherited conditions
Evaluating risks from exposure to mutagens or teratogens
Helping individuals/families understand medical and psychosocial implications
Facilitating decision-making regarding testing or medical interventions
Ordering genetic tests pursuant to a collaborative agreement
Selecting appropriate methods of diagnosis pursuant to a collaborative agreement
methods_authorized.quote: Estimating the likelihood of occurrence or recurrence of a birth defect or of any potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition

drug_authority.value: Pursuant to a collaborative agreement with a board-certified physician, a genetic counselor may order genetic tests or other evaluations to diagnose a condition or determine carrier status, and select the most appropriate methods of diagnosis.
drug_authority.quote: Pursuant to a collaborative agreement: (i) Ordering genetic tests or other evaluations to diagnose a condition or determine the carrier status of one or more family members, including testing for inherited disorders; and (ii) Selecting the most appropriate, accurate, and cost-effective methods of diagnosis.
